title: 第11章 初心第12章 玩大了昊天剑匣
slug: 我只想毁灭宗门咋逆天成神了
lines: 灵冢之中的一切都在昊天镜之中清楚的显示出来。
每个人在做什么也看的一清二楚。
有的人一进去就按照自己提前得到的小道消息的位置疯狂寻找过去，面对四周其他同门的求助，别说帮忙了，多看你一眼都算我输。
可是反观楚星河这边，面对同门寻求帮助，楚星河是来者不拒。
这一对比之下，那是高下立判啊。
“我昊天宗，名列天下第一宗，门下弟子无一不是天赋绝伦，可天赋固然重要，秉性却也决定未来，诸位有何感想啊？”
大长老的声音很轻，但却清楚传入每一位长老的耳中，宗主闭关期间，大长老代管宗门各项事务，自然也管理每一位长老，这会儿大长老虽然没有明说，但言语之间的意思大家却都明白。
这不就等于是跟大家说，看看吧……你们挑选出来的这些心仪的弟子，这特么都是在干啥？
一个个的为了自己都是抛开同门不管不顾，这就是你们挑选的弟子？
“大长老教训的是，我等必将思改。”
众多长老也是汗颜啊。
这就是人比人啊，以前灵冢开启的时候，大家也都是差不多的，自然没有人说什么，但是今天的楚星河表现太过耀眼，以至于其他人一下子全都成了衬托。
而最让人无奈的是，对于楚星河这个孩子，众多长老哪怕是被大长老责难也说不出什么来，咋说？怪楚星河帮助同门了？
昊天宗虽然分很多山头很多宫，但昊天宗从来都是一个无比团结的宗门，能成为天下第一宗绝非偶然，可这些刚入门的弟子对这个显然还不了解，一心只想着自己，却忘记了灵冢大会并不是比武大会，要争个你死我活，身边的人也不是敌人对手，而是同气连枝的同门师兄弟啊。
灵冢之中，丘林宫的妹子们跟上楚星河的脚步，而不光她们，越来越多的人跟上了楚星河的脚步。
对于这个不惜花费自己时间也要帮助同门引路的核心弟子，大家是心服口服。
要不说人家是核心弟子呢，是真仁义啊。
“诸位师弟师妹们，我也跟你们一样是第一次进入灵冢，虽然听一些师兄说过灵冢之中的事情，可了解的也并不算多，灵兵的挑选乃是靠自己的缘分，我为大家引路但最终能拿到什么样的灵兵还要看大家自己与灵兵的缘分到没到，若是没有拿到让大家满意的灵兵，还请大家莫要怪罪。”
楚星河这番话顿时让身后的师弟师妹们泪目啊。
“星河师兄好意我们铭记于心。”
“星河师兄无需如此，能为我们引路已经是师兄仁至义尽了。”
“星河师兄太帅了！”
万霖跟在楚星河身后，眼睛里都是小星星，她本来只是抱着试一试的打算，可没想到星河师兄人竟然这么好。
在楚星河的带领下，大家一路向前，而随着不断向前走，周围的灵兵种类也逐渐多了起来，很显然这条路应该是正确的。
灵冢之中道路千万条，有的甚至可能通向压根没有灵兵的地方，所以走错路那可是很麻烦的，而楚星河所走的这条路正是之前拿到的路线，不过楚星河可不是要带着大家前往最后的神剑位置，而是要去……
很快，随着前面一个转弯，楚星河找到了自己要找的地方。
这里跟其他地方有些不同，因为在大家的前面竟然出现了一块石碑。
“灵池！”
万霖看清了前面石碑上的字，而这灵池大家也是知道的。
灵池算得上是整个灵冢的最中心区域了，这里也是昊天宗最早的灵冢所在，当年昊天宗的先祖们死后，灵兵也落在了灵池这里。
而看到灵池，楚星河开口了：“就是这里了，诸位师弟师妹可以在这里选择自己需要的灵兵！”
楚星河说完指了指灵池的位置。
可是这话刚落下，包括万霖在内，周围无数人都懵了。
“星河师兄不知道这里是什么地方吗？”
万霖愣神。
“知道啊，灵池！”
“那星河师兄怎么还让我们在这里挑选灵兵？”
“对啊……灵池乃是最早昊天宗灵冢所在，这里的灵兵也是最古老的一批……”
“没错，这些灵兵很多甚至都破损了，就算没破损的也都是最差的，星河师兄这是什么意思啊！”
“在这里挑选灵兵？这不是坑人吗？”
一时间四周乱了套，正如大家所说的那样，昊天宗最早的灵池之中放着昊天宗最早的先祖们的灵兵，可是同样的，那个时代的昊天宗还不是天下第一宗，那个时代昊天宗的灵池之中灵兵可远没有现在这么丰富多样，所以无论是灵兵的能力还是其他都不如现在的好。
楚星河让大家在这里挑选这明显就是坑人啊。
content_en:
Everything in the spiritual tomb is clearly displayed in the Haotian Mirror.
You can see clearly what everyone is doing.
As soon as some people enter, they frantically search for the location based on the gossip they got in advance. Faced with requests for help from other disciples around them, let alone help, I will lose if I look at you even more.
But on Chu Xinghe's side, when his fellow disciples asked for help, Chu Xinghe would not refuse anyone who came.
In this comparison, it is a judgment of superiority.
"Our Haotian Sect is ranked number one in the world, and all of our disciples are extremely talented. But talent is important, but character also determines the future. What do you think?"
The great elder's voice was very soft, but it reached the ears of every elder clearly. During the sect leader's retreat, the great elder was in charge of various affairs of the sect, and naturally also managed every elder. Although the great elder did not say it clearly at this time, everyone understood the meaning of his words.
Doesn't this mean I'm telling everyone, let's take a look... what the hell are these disciples you selected doing?
Each and every one of them has abandoned their fellow disciples for their own sake. Is this the disciple you selected?
"What the Great Elder taught us is that we must change our minds."
Many elders are also ashamed.
This is how people compare with each other. When the spiritual tomb was opened in the past, everyone was about the same, so naturally no one said anything, but today Chu Xinghe's performance was so dazzling that everyone else suddenly became a foil.
And the most helpless thing is that many elders can't say anything about this child Chu Xinghe even if they are criticized by the great elder. How can they say that? Do you blame Chu Xinghe for helping his fellow disciples?
Although the Haotian Sect is divided into many mountains and palaces, the Haotian Sect has always been an extremely united sect, and it is no accident that it became the number one sect in the world. However, these new disciples obviously don't understand this yet. They only think about themselves, but they forget that the Tomb of Tombs Conference is not a martial arts competition. If you want to fight to the death, the people around you are not enemies and rivals, but brothers and sisters of the same sect.
In the spiritual tomb, the girls from Qiulin Palace followed Chu Xinghe's footsteps, and not only them, more and more people followed Chu Xinghe's footsteps.
Everyone is convinced by this core disciple who does not hesitate to spend his own time to help his fellow disciples lead the way.
To say that he is a core disciple is truly benevolent and righteous.
"Junior brothers and sisters, it is my first time to enter the spiritual tomb like you. Although I have heard from some senior brothers about the things in the spiritual tomb, I don't know much about it. The selection of spiritual soldiers depends on your own fate. I will lead the way for you. But what kind of spiritual soldiers you can get in the end depends on your fate with the spiritual soldiers. If you don't get the spiritual soldiers that satisfy you, please don't blame me."
Chu Xinghe's words immediately made the junior brothers and sisters behind him burst into tears.
“Senior Brother Xinghe’s kindness will be kept in our hearts.”
"Senior Brother Xinghe doesn't need to be like this. Being able to lead the way for us is already the utmost kindness of Senior Brother."
"Senior Brother Xinghe is so handsome!"
Wan Lin followed Chu Xinghe with stars in her eyes. She originally just had the intention of giving it a try, but she didn't expect that Senior Brother Xinghe was so nice.
Under the leadership of Chu Xinghe, everyone moved forward. As they continued to move forward, the types of spiritual soldiers around them gradually increased. It was obvious that this path should be the right one.
There are thousands of roads in the spiritual tomb, and some may even lead to places where there are no spiritual soldiers at all, so it will be very troublesome to take the wrong road. The road Chu Xinghe took is the route he got before, but Chu Xinghe is not taking everyone to the final location of the divine sword, but to...
Soon, following a turn ahead, Chu Xinghe found the place he was looking for.
This place is a little different from other places, because there is a stone tablet in front of everyone.
"Spirit pool!"
Wan Lin saw clearly the words on the stone tablet in front, and everyone knew about this Lingchi.
The Lingchi can be regarded as the most central area of ​​the entire spiritual tomb. This is also where the earliest spiritual tomb of the Haotian Sect is located. When the ancestors of the Haotian Sect died, the spiritual soldiers also fell here in the Lingchi.
Seeing the spirit pool, Chu Xinghe spoke: "This is it. Junior brothers and sisters can choose the spiritual weapons you need here!"
After speaking, Chu Xinghe pointed to the location of the spirit pool.
But as soon as these words were spoken, countless people around him, including Wan Lin, were stunned.
"Senior Brother Xinghe, don't you know where this place is?"
Wan Lin was stunned.
"I know, Lingchi!"
"Then why does Brother Xinghe still let us select spiritual soldiers here?"
"That's right... the spiritual pool is where the earliest Haotian Sect spiritual tomb is located, and the spiritual soldiers here are also the oldest group..."
"Yes, many of these spiritual soldiers are even damaged. Even the ones that are not damaged are the worst. Brother Xinghe, what do you mean?"
"Selecting spiritual soldiers here? Isn't this a scam?"
Everything was in chaos for a while. As everyone said, the earliest spiritual pool of Haotian Sect contained the spiritual soldiers of the earliest ancestors of Haotian Sect. However, at that time, the Haotian Sect was not the best sect in the world. The spiritual soldiers of Haotian Sect in that era were far from as rich and diverse as they are now, so the abilities of the spiritual soldiers and other things were not as good as they are now.
Chu Xinghe asked everyone to choose here, which is obviously a trick.
